voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Scotland, December nineteen hundred. On a remote island in the Atlantic, the lighthouse went dark.
Storms held the relief boat back until Boxing Day. When it finally landed, no one came down to meet it.
The lamps had been cleaned and refilled. One man's oilskins were still inside. Investigators concluded he had gone out without them.
High on the west cliff, a box of ropes kept a hundred and ten feet above the sea had been smashed open.
The inquiry blamed an unusually large wave. Not one of the three keepers was ever found.
